purpose: Fixed-question report from a fresh independent simulated beginner using only visible mouse interaction.
persona: Simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

rating_reasons.easy_to_use: Visible double-click-for-MIDI guidance, the instrument assignment button, note generator, and labeled mixer controls let me complete the requested mouse workflow. Duplicate behaved as a tool instead of an immediate command, and exact trimming took a second drag.
rating_reasons.how_cool_it_looks: The dark teal arranger, visible note previews, colored bus, and routing lines made the project feel coherent and polished. The native file picker looked visually separate.
rating_reasons.how_fast_it_is: Generating 56 notes and duplicating audio took few actions, and MIDI export returned quickly. Initial playback errors and retry attempts slowed the session; WAV export displayed a running elapsed counter before success. This rating is subjective and includes laboratory conditions.
rating_reasons.how_confusing_it_is: Most main labels were clear. Duplicate required clicking a clip after choosing the tool. Reappearing audio-error banners moved the mixer controls vertically, causing missed solo clicks. System default output failed until I selected the named lab output.
rating_reasons.feature_completeness: I found audio and MIDI arrangement, a VST3 instrument, note generation, volume/pan/mute/solo, a bus and send, a mouse naming keyboard, project save, and both exports. I did not test effects, recording, automation, or other plug-ins.

findings.observation: Double-clicking the visible MIDI drop area opened the instrument library; Assign instrument created a MIDI track showing Rill Lab Sine.

Generate notes previewed an arpeggio on the piano roll. I selected minor triad and 0.5x speed, then used Next range to create C minor, F minor, G minor, and C minor phrases; the arrangement title showed 0:30.000.
Clicking Duplicate repeatedly selected a tool without adding clips. The hint then said Click a clip to duplicate; clicking the clip added an adjacent copy.
Duplicated drums reached 34.286 seconds. Trimming the last right edge first produced 30.134 seconds; a small second drag aligned the duration to 30.000.
Dragging mixer faders changed displayed levels to -7.5 dB for drums and -7.1 dB for the MIDI instrument. Horizontal pan drags displayed L11 and R13.

The audio-error banner appeared and disappeared during playback retries, changing mixer control positions. My first attempts at Solo hit the old vertical position; a later screenshot showed the Solo button active.
Add bus created New bus. The instrument Add send button opened routing; + Send offered New bus. Selecting it showed a 0.25x Post send, and the mixer displayed a routing line to the bus.
Rename project exposed a Keyboard button. I used its on-screen keys to enter rain, applied the name, and saved rain.rill through the native picker. The unsaved indicator disappeared.
WAV export showed Arrangement 0:30; I unchecked effect tails and accepted rain.wav. Both WAV and MIDI exports displayed explicit Exported notices.
Initial Play and Retry playback attempts produced Audio output stream failed or disconnected. Error details named an ALSA snd_pcm_avail_delay I/O error and System default output.

I opened Audio setup from the error banner, selected Rill lab paced output instead of System default, and applied. A subsequent Play showed a moving playhead and active audio, MIDI, bus, and master meters.
After playback recovered, I again activated drum Mute and instrument Solo, observed highlighted buttons, restored both, stopped playback, and saved.

outcome.status: Completed through the visible UI: 30-second audio plus VST MIDI arrangement, named and saved project, WAV and MIDI success notices, and requested mixer actions. Sound quality and artifact contents remain unverified by this participant.
outcome.composition: 112 BPM, 4/4. Startup Circuit rhythm drums duplicated into three four-bar clips plus a final two-bar trimmed clip. One 14-bar MIDI pattern with 56 generated notes: four bars each of C minor, F minor, and G minor arpeggios at 0.5x, then two bars of C minor. Intended as a relaxed sketch; no auditory judgment.
outcome.playback_observed: Initially failed with an audio stream error, including after retries; one failed attempt advanced the displayed position to 003.02.07. After selecting Rill lab paced output, the arranger playhead moved, transport advanced from 001.02.29 to 005.04.34 and later 010.03.93, and audio/MIDI/bus/master meters showed activity. No heard-audio claim.

limitations: No project, WAV, or MIDI contents inspected; output paths came from visible native pickers and project error details. Independent coordinator verification follows.
No audio capture auditioned. Mixer balancing was performed using displayed values and later meter activity, so audible balance and musical quality are unknown.
Laboratory software graphics, timer-paced virtual audio sink, and no physical audio or MIDI hardware. Initial output failure and recovery must not be generalized to hardware performance.
The only tested instrument was the installed Rill Lab Sine VST3, not other third-party plug-ins.
Session elapsed time includes screenshots, tool calls, and reporting overhead; it is not a speed benchmark.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both mixer faders. Drum display changed from -6.0 to -7.5 dB; instrument from -2.5 to -7.1 dB. Later playback showed meter activity; no audible balance claim.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged both mixer pan knobs horizontally. Final displayed pan was drum L11 and instrument R13.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked drum Mute, saw it highlighted, then restored it. Repeated during recovered playback and restored before final save.
mixer_outcome.solo: Initial clicks missed after banner-driven layout shifts. A later click visibly highlighted instrument Solo. Restored it, then repeated during recovered playback and restored before final save.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus appeared as a bus strip at 0.0 dB with output to Master. After adding the send it showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Instrument Add send opened routing. + Send > New bus added a 0.25x Post send. The strip showed Send · New bus and a Post send routing line; later bus meter activity was visible.
